selector.rationale: Sweet syndrome best explains the clinical presentation of fever, tender lesions, and specific skin biopsy findings, including the presence of myeloperoxidase-positive cells and inflammatory infiltrate, without contradiction.

rejected.label: Drug rash
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and low score

rejected.label: Neutrophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: Less specific findings and lower score compared to Sweet syndrome

rejected.label: Leukemic cutis
rejected.why: Less specific and lower score compared to Leukemia cutis, which is also a less likely diagnosis due to the presence of myeloperoxidase-positive cells and other findings more consistent with Sweet syndrome
